freeStanding.text: I see myself as someone who tries to keep others safe, even when that means taking the harder position.
I understand myself as someone who prepares carefully before making a dangerous choice.
I am someone who wants to understand what is happening before deciding what to do.
I see my role as helping the people beside me do their best work.
I value being able to make my own decisions and find my own way forward.
I see myself as someone who solves difficult problems with whatever honest tools I have available.
I want to be someone others can depend on when a decision needs to be made.
I prefer to look for a way through conflict that does not demand another fight.
I think of myself as someone who takes action when waiting would put others at risk.
I am more comfortable making progress quietly than being the center of attention.
I want to be someone who can face the unfamiliar with care and curiosity.
I understand myself best when I am learning how something works and how to make it useful again.
I place a great deal of importance on the people I trust and the relationships I build.
I know my direction has changed. I want my choices now to matter more than the label you gave me before.
I don't think one role explains all of me. I want you to recognize that I can be several things at once.
I am still working out who I am. I want that uncertainty to be part of your understanding of me.
I know what I have learned, but I don't want my current abilities to decide my whole future for me.
I want to keep learning before I choose a single path to describe myself.
